coverage.exception_policy: Any missing/nonpositive/duplicate source value causes a source failure; the calculation has no secondary-source replacement path.

derived_runtime_provenance.adapter: direct anonymous HTTPS requests to Eastmoney public fund history endpoint

hard_limitations: Public rows were retrospectively captured and do not establish original-date availability, revision lineage, field semantics, data rights or a complete total-return ledger.

Displayed accumulated NAV is not an executable exchange-market price; market price/NAV/IOPV, fund events, halts, limits, lot size, bid/ask, fills, fees, taxes, settlement and suitability are not modeled.
The five-code group is representative only, not U0, an historical population, a decision universe or an allocation recommendation.
This cannot close UR01--UR05 or establish individual action feasibility, even if the proxy hurdle is not falsified.

pre_observation_disclosure.description: Before this rule was written, the research session used akshare.fund_etf_fund_info_em to check Eastmoney historical-NAV field availability and viewed sample/history responses for at least some relevant codes. Those responses were not retained as R5 source files and no R5 rule calculation was run at that time.
pre_observation_disclosure.effect: This is not a clean pre-registration before any related historical response was seen. Positive outputs cannot be used as independent out-of-sample or strategy evidence; negative outputs remain exploratory only.
pre_observation_disclosure.legacy_filename_boundary: The filename retains predeclared for continuity only and must not be interpreted as a clean preregistration claim.

simulation.cost_boundary: Illustrative load only; not an execution, fee, tax, spread, impact, fill, settlement or capacity assertion.

evaluation.terminal_calendar_year_rule: terminal calendar year is eligible only when the final common observation is on calendar December 31
evaluation.terminal_rolling_month_rule: terminal month is eligible only when the final common observation is on its calendar month end

rule.equity_signal_sleeve_convention: fixed_base_buy_and_hold_equal_weighted_level; selected-equity targets reset to 50/50 only at strategy rebalances
rule.signal_timing: last common observation of calendar month
rule.target_weight_rule: equal weight across all eligible sleeves; if none is eligible, 100% fallback_money_market

simulation.strategy_rule: Monthly absolute momentum across one locked equity sleeve, one government-bond sleeve and one gold sleeve; equal weight among positive sleeves; locked money-market ETF fallback only when none is positive.

terminal_observation_policy.boundary: A terminal period is assessed only when the final common observation reaches the relevant calendar end; otherwise it is excluded as incomplete.

capture_implementation_provenance.assessment: The original capture-script file was not separately retained. The archived raw-response bundles still pass byte and response-digest checks, but source-capture implementation equivalence between the frozen runtime SHA and the current derivation file cannot be verified.
capture_implementation_provenance.effect: This is an audit limitation, not a reason to change the retained raw files or to infer that their contents are point-in-time, executable or entitled data.
capture_implementation_provenance.metadata_boundary: This disclosure is post-capture metadata only. No raw bundle, raw-response digest, frozen-file entry or source-freeze field was changed.

strict_proxy_hurdle.boundary: The state is only a result of the stated public-NAV proxy arithmetic. It is not an investor-return result, guarantee, forecast, recommendation or action decision.
failures: At least one complete calendar-year proxy metric is below the fixed 5% hurdle.
At least one rolling-five-year proxy endpoint is below the fixed 5% hurdle.

turnover_and_cost_summary.interpretation: The cost sum is the arithmetic sum of per-rebalance illustrative fractions; it is not a compounded-return drag or an execution-cost estimate.
